checks.summary: The stdio startup, exact two-tool discovery contract, and machine-readable schemas are specific and testable.
Capability discovery is tied to the exact live mirror, versioned metadata, stable IDs, defaults, bounds, and browser-visible controls.
The render acceptance covers one valid image, every preset class, browser UI mutation, and Dresser's own PNG export.
Artifact location, MIME type, byte size, SHA-256, dimensions, PNG signature, existence, and visual preset reflection are observable.
Sequential isolation and overlapping-call serialization or stable busy rejection are explicitly testable.
Input, schema, capability, browser, mirror, timeout, and download negative paths require bounded non-leaking errors and no stale artifact.
Network, log-redaction, source privacy, and temporary-state cleanup boundaries are explicit and reproducible.
Neighbor preservation and task-scoped MCP gates are required, while full-repository lint is a strict no-regression comparison against the exact accepted preflight baseline.
The task owns the test directory and package script addition needed to make the frozen MCP test command real during implementation.
The corrected required command is task-scoped MCP lint, and package.json plus task-owned server files are in scope to define and satisfy it.
The corrected task-scoped MCP build command is explicitly owned through package.json and the task-owned server files.
Fresh preflight execution validated every entry in the exact mirror manifest.
Fresh preflight execution of git diff --check passed.
The check requires live MCP schema validation and reconciliation against browser-visible mirror controls.
The solid and mesh scenarios exercise materially different settings and explicitly distinguish Dresser export from browser screenshots.
The required failure matrix covers file, media, preset, browser, mirror, timeout, download, leakage, and stale-artifact behavior.
The check specifies clean-page reset, distinct sequential jobs, overlapping calls, unique outputs, and no overwrite.
The check observes network, logs, MCP errors, media payloads, source identity, and temporary filesystem cleanup.
The interactive mirror route, exact mirror integrity, scoped diff, existing portfolio, and prior editor ownership are explicit regression boundaries.
A fresh full-repository lint run exactly reproduced the frozen 10-error, five-file out-of-scope baseline; the packet rejects any changed or task-owned finding.
Ownership remains bounded to MCP implementation, tests, documentation, and required package metadata; the corrected lint policy no longer requires edits to excluded portfolio files.
Closed versioned schemas, exact two-tool discovery, bounded errors, clean browser state, and direct MCP tests cover the API boundary.
The browser integration is loopback-only, disposable, timeout-bounded, and excluded from public transport or deployment.
Source validation, no arbitrary output path, log and error redaction, loopback traffic, cleanup, and intentional-artifact retention are frozen.
